company.name: Gravity Sketch
company.shortDescription: Gravity Sketch is a VR-based design and collaboration platform that allows distributed teams to create, share, and build in 3D.
company.description:
Gravity Sketch is powering design teams that need to think, collaborate, and create in three dimensions. They build intuitive multi-platform tools to radically improve the efficacy and efficiency of developing 3D products.

Their energy is focussed entirely on their customers - removing friction from their archaic workflows, helping enhance and expedite their creative intent, and ultimately, making collaboration in cross-functional teams faster and more cost-effective.

It was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in London, England.

productsAndServices.description: A VR-based platform enabling 3D design and collaboration for teams, compatible with various VR headsets and accessible on desktop for reviewing and feedback.
productsAndServices.name: Gravity Sketch VR Design Platform

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based hub for managing, sharing, and accessing 2D and 3D design content across devices, featuring a library of reference models.
productsAndServices.name: LandingPad

productsAndServices.description: Service offering dedicated design consultants to help integrate Gravity Sketch into organizations, including customized training and support for adopting 3D design workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Design Consultancy

productsAndServices.description: A licensing model designed to facilitate the adoption of Gravity Sketch by allowing experimentation beyond the number of purchased licenses during the first year.
productsAndServices.name: Flexible Licensing

productsAndServices.description: A program that partners with design universities to prepare students in using Gravity Sketch, providing a pipeline of skilled designers to enterprise customers.
productsAndServices.name: Talent Pipeline Support

productsAndServices.description: Features access and permissions controls for asset management and controlled product updates to meet enterprise security standards.
productsAndServices.name: Security & Stability

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $32,534,926, or 77.77% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 3 disclosed grants total $3,902,069, representing 9.33% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,958,027 to $145,249,134, a 18.25x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 28 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include ShapesXR, Arkio, Cosm.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
